description: No external validation dataset has been obtained for this repository. All runs in outputs/runs/ carry status INTERNAL_RESEARCH. The protocol draft in EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_DRAFT.md documents how external validation would be run if a dataset becomes available.
known_issues: Coverage of the primary interval on the locked holdout is 0.9087 at target 0.90; the longest-turnaround tail remains the weakest region (late-miss rate 0.692 on cases at or above the P90 remaining threshold).
